metaTitle: FNS40821 Cert IV Mortgage Broking RPL — Online
metaDescription: Working in lending or broking? Get the FNS40821 Certificate IV in Finance and Mortgage Broking through RPL. 100% online. Free eligibility check.
heroIntro: The FNS40821 Certificate IV in Finance and Mortgage Broking is the minimum qualification for mortgage brokers in Australia. If you already work in lending or broking, RPL lets you get it online using evidence from the loans you've written and the clients you've served.
whoIsItFor:
• Loan writers and broker assistants moving into a broking role
  • Lending staff and home loan specialists from banks
  • Credit analysts and loan processors
  • Brokers with older or incomplete qualifications

Candidates usually have a year or more in lending: identifying client needs, preparing loan applications, presenting options, and working within credit laws and industry codes.
evidenceExamples:
• Loan files and applications you've prepared (with client details removed)
  • Needs analysis and preliminary assessment documents
  • Credit guides, compliance checklists and file notes
  • Lender accreditation or industry association records
  • Professional development records
  • A reference from your aggregator, principal broker or lending manager
licensingInfo:
Mortgage brokers are regulated under the National Consumer Credit Protection Act. ASIC's training standards require brokers to hold at least the Certificate IV in Finance and Mortgage Broking, and you must work under an Australian Credit Licence, either your own or as a credit representative of a licensee. Industry associations such as the MFAA and FBAA set membership requirements, which usually include completing the Diploma of Finance and Mortgage Broking Management within a set time.

If you are new to lending, RPL usually isn't the right path. You'll need training first. We can tell you which applies to you.
description:
The FNS40821 Certificate IV in Finance and Mortgage Broking covers the work of a mortgage broker: identifying client needs and presenting broking options, preparing loan applications, complying with financial services regulation and industry codes, applying knowledge of financial products, working to professional practices, managing your professional development and building relationships in the financial services industry.

It replaces FNS40820 and FNS40815.

faqs.q: Can I get the Certificate IV in Mortgage Broking through RPL?
faqs.a: Yes, if you already work in lending or broking. Your loan files, needs analyses and compliance documents are assessed against the units.

faqs.q: Is the Certificate IV enough to become a mortgage broker?
faqs.a: It is the minimum qualification ASIC expects. You also need to work under an Australian Credit Licence, and industry associations usually require the Diploma within a set time.
Usually 4 to 8 weeks.
Yes, 100% online from anywhere in Australia.
The cost depends on your evidence and any gap training. RPL is usually much cheaper than full study. Ask for a free eligibility check.

metaTitle: FNS60222 Advanced Diploma of Accounting RPL
metaDescription: Senior accountant? Get the FNS60222 Advanced Diploma of Accounting through RPL. 100% online, Australia-wide. Free eligibility check.
heroIntro: The FNS60222 Advanced Diploma of Accounting is the highest vocational accounting qualification. If you already work as a senior accountant or financial controller, RPL lets you get it online using evidence from your accounting work.
whoIsItFor:
• Senior accountants and financial accountants
  • Financial controllers and finance managers
  • Accountants in practice with complex clients
  • Accountants who trained overseas

Candidates usually have several years of accounting work, including financial reporting, corporate governance, using financial statistics and tools, and applying economic principles.

Entry requirements: you must have completed the FNS50222 (or FNS50217) Diploma of Accounting or equivalent, including the unit BSBTEC402 Design and produce complex spreadsheets. See the FNS50222 Diploma of Accounting.
evidenceExamples:
• Financial statements and reports you've prepared
  • Consolidations, tax workpapers or audit files
  • Governance or board reporting you've contributed to
  • Financial analysis, forecasts and models
  • Your Diploma of Accounting
  • A reference from your CFO, partner or finance manager
licensingInfo: A vocational accounting qualification doesn't make you a registered tax agent or a CPA or CA member on its own. The Tax Practitioners Board sets its own education and experience requirements for tax agents, and professional bodies set their own entry rules. This qualification can be part of those pathways.
description:
The FNS60222 Advanced Diploma of Accounting covers senior accounting work: monitoring corporate governance, applying economic principles in financial services, and interpreting and using financial statistics and tools.

Electives cover areas such as financial reporting for complex entities, tax, management accounting and auditing. It replaces FNS60217.

faqs.q: Can I get the Advanced Diploma of Accounting through RPL?
faqs.a: Yes, if you work in a senior accounting role and hold the Diploma of Accounting. Your financial reports, analysis and a senior reference are assessed against the units.

faqs.q: Do I need the Diploma of Accounting first?
faqs.a: Yes, the Diploma (or equivalent) is an entry requirement. If you don't have it, you can usually get the Diploma through RPL first.

faqs.q: Will it make me a registered tax agent?
faqs.a: Not on its own. The Tax Practitioners Board has its own education and experience requirements. This qualification can be part of meeting them.
Usually 6 to 10 weeks.
The cost depends on your evidence and any gap training. RPL is usually much cheaper than full study. Ask for a free eligibility check.

whoIsItFor:
• Bank and credit officers
  • Insurance and superannuation team leaders
  • Compliance and operations staff in financial services

evidenceExamples:

Tell us the role or licence you need it for, and we'll check whether this Diploma and its electives fit.

metaTitle: FNS60822 Adv Diploma Integrated Risk Management RPL
metaDescription: Manage risk or compliance? Get the FNS60822 Advanced Diploma of Integrated Risk Management through RPL, online. Free eligibility check.
heroIntro: The FNS60822 Advanced Diploma of Integrated Risk Management is the senior qualification for risk and compliance professionals. If you already identify and assess risk, run compliance systems or write risk policy, RPL lets you get it online using evidence from your work.
whoIsItFor:
• Risk managers and risk analysts
  • Compliance managers and officers
  • Governance and audit staff
  • Operations managers responsible for risk

Candidates usually have several years in risk or compliance, in financial services or any other industry, managing risk frameworks, mitigation plans and compliance reviews.
evidenceExamples:
• Risk registers, assessments and treatment plans
  • Compliance frameworks, reviews and breach reports
  • Policies and procedures you have written

description:
The FNS60822 Advanced Diploma of Integrated Risk Management covers enterprise risk and compliance. Its eight core units are identifying, assessing and mitigating risk, managing risk exposure, managing business risk, establishing and reviewing compliance management systems, evaluating compliance, and developing and monitoring policy and procedures, plus four electives.

It replaces FNS60820.

faqs.q: Do I need to work in financial services?
